reviews.title: Spelling error
reviews.text: It did not fill me with confidence when I downloaded the app from the email sent to me by the RAC, but was not able to get into it. Instead it replied with this message  which included a spelling mistake! It stated …oops something went wrong, the link may of expired… surely that’s meant to say the Link may have expired???

reviews.title: Utter trash of a service
reviews.text: Worst app ever. No number to call anyone and my car shows as having nil cover despite it being brand new with ‘complimentary’ 12-month all in cover. Attempting to ring through the manufacturer’s site and selecting ‘breakdown’ gives an automatic recording stating I have a current breakdown and someone will attend within the next hour. Well I haven’t reported any breakdown. Absolutely useless company.

reviews.title: GarnP
reviews.text: My wife and I took our annual holiday in  Northumberland this year, through no fault of the RAC, we had a problem with our car, as this happened near our hotel, Saturday night, we waited until Monday morning to ring the rac, as it was still drivable, When we rang the rac, they told us that they had no patrols in the area, this was , Seahouses a very popular spot for tourists, and the earliest they could get to us was Wednesday, being disgusted I rang around, ,  local garages, also put our plight on the SOS vehicle repair centres. The best halp we had was from the AA, not a member nor never been a member,              On Wednesday morning a RAC van came, the driver was very polite and checked all round, he said it was problem he could not fix but we SHOULD be ok to just go carefully, that’s the rest of our holiday and the over 200 miles back home, we stayed locally near our hotel until Saturday,    On Saturday we set off for home, only to get half an hour down the A1 and the fault came back, we rang the RAC again and told them we wanted recovery as we are Both OVER 80 and I am disabled and relying on my mobility scooter when not in the vehicle, the said I was priority case and would get a parole to me as soon as possible the hours went by ( six and a half in total) then the driver said he could only take us to Scotch Corner, the-be off loaded,  then wait for another vehicle to take us the rest of the way home,               It took us from 10.15am to 10.50pm to get home.

reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.text:
Logged van around 3pm ish! Couldn’t drive it..Was told between 8-11!
 Not happy then it changed to 4-4.30 so that’s fine but the bloke who rocked up couldn’t tow me cos his trailer is broken! Completely pointless visit! He told me 60-90 mins but then my new time came through 8-11! I’m in a safe place so no real guarantee anyone will come out now! Got to around 5.20 and still 8-11 so had no choice really but to pay £270 to be recovered! Medication at home and the van had been booked back into the garage! It was a new engine! Thanks for nothing …

reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the Service
reviews.text:
Reported the over heating & smoke from the vehicle when drove back home. RAC petrol arrived started at the engine, it was very noisy and his computer showed multiple cylinder misfiring. He ran the engine for half an hour, when the engine quieten down, he said the car is okay you can drive it. 
When I questioned him about his computer report and the problem I experience his response was it is okay now. He refused to take the car to the garage. Extremely dissatisfied with the Service.

reviews.title: Mr Andy
reviews.text: On the few times I have needed to ring them up over last couple of years , have not had help from them ,first time when needed a home recovery,and guy that turned up didn’t have a clue ,and wasn’t interested,he just hooked his laptop up to my car and said there is no faults coming up ,told me it was probably to do with my fuel tank sensor ,I googled what he was saying and google told me my car did not have what he was suggesting,  my next door neighbour who is 80 years old said I know what it is .its either the spark plugs or the coil pack,so went to shop they said just try the spark plugs for now ,so I did and hey presto it has started fine every time since,, then I was stuck miles from home in a dangerous situation,my key had jammed in lock and they said the key will be broke and you need a locksmith,, so I rang the locksmith they gave me the number for ,he gave me a quote of several hundreds of pounds, I rang my 80 year old neighbour again he said do you have any WD40 in the car. I said I do he said spray some in the lock and try again in 10 minutes, so I did and again hey presto it worked ., so definitely will not be using this breakdown company again,utterly useless ,,

reviews.title: Call-out charge and app are really poor
reviews.text: Having to pay £40 for each callout is robbery, as I was not informed of this charge when I signed up for the year. Worse, if you don't have a card with you when you ask for roadside assistance (and I don't carry cards, as I use my phone to pay for everything), then you are stuck: The app didn't accept Apple Pay for payment. Because of this, it took me more than 30 mins before I was even able to book roadside assistance for my car breakdown, which added a lot to the stress I was under. Please make the app a lot easier to use or, better, include all call-out fees in the annual charge!

reviews.title: Communcation
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with the RAC. It seems almost impossible to speak to a real person when you want to cancel a policy. Everything pushes you towards automated systems, which is incredibly frustrating when you have a simple request.
To make matters worse, money has been taken from my bank account, yet my policy still says it needs renewing. The lack of clear communication and the inability to get through to someone who can resolve the issue is unacceptable.
Customer service should be there when customers need it most. Based on my experience, I would not recommend the RAC until they make it much easier to speak to a real person and sort out billing issues promptly.

reviews.title: Disgraceful service
reviews.text:
We want to cancel our membership with immediate effect. The disgraceful way you treated two elderly people in their 70’s and left us there for 7 hours and at one stage said our pick up had been cancelled was disgusting !!!! Initially you sent someone who decided the car wasn’t driveable and wanted to take us to a garage in Totnes !!!! I asked him if there wasn’t any closer and he just shrugged his shoulders. I then had to tell him where there was a garage in Brixham where we live.
After having the arrival of the flat bed truck put back three times and also, at one stage, messaged that it had been cancelled, my wife and myself were in a terrible state of feeling we were just going to be left in the middle of nowhere. Also we had to pay £429 for the privilege of this disgusting treatment.
Therefore if this is an example of your service for two elders who have been left in a state of perpetual worry and trauma and both have serious health issues, we will find another recovery service as yours is appalling.
Thank you for your dreadful service !!!!!
Henry and Jacqueline Hubball.

reviews.title: Electric cars use Electricity
reviews.text:
I’m looking for the section giving information about where the nearest place to recharge my car is. Usually I’ve been in the dark and more desperate to find out . I couldn’t find out on this App. It’s all about Which fuel? Diesel or petrol, but nothing about electricity. It’s amazing how nobody knows, and it’s only by word of mouth that I found out that the BP GARAGE had electric charge points. Thd next challenge was to find someone to tell me how they work. The staff in the garage shop said it’s nothing to do with them! I was lucky because a customer helped me. 
Please provide the information I need to find out in an emergency.

reviews.title: M4 breakdown
reviews.text: Today 16/02 we broke down on the m4 having driven from se London and contacted the factory ask for help, we were told to do everything on the internet which was ok because we have decent mobiles and we were advised that someone would  contact us when a repairer was on the way .  We waited for two hours and no sign of anyone coming apart from being told he was 24 minutes away after waiting an hour I  tried the engine again and could get ourselves off the motorway to safety eventually we managed to advise the call centre we had moved so we had to cancel the call out and if we broke down again we would have to start from the beginning.   This is the first time we have used the rac and not sure we will be staying with them .  We are used to Green Flag who wee always to us in less than an hour

reviews.title: Annoying promotion spam
reviews.text:
Sends almost daily promotion push notifications with no way to turn them off. Reached out to their support who do not know their own app as they told me there was an option to do it. When I told them there isn't they advised I disable all notifications for the app via the iOS settings. Told them I didn't want to do that because I imagine I'll need notifications in the event of a breakdown, I just don't want constant ads, and they blanked me. Can't we just have a breakdown cover app without a constant barrage of "deals"?

As one of those apps people like to keep on their phone just-in-case, it's repulsive that it's used as a platform to push ads at you.

reviews.title: Shocking
reviews.text:
Worst breakdown experience I’ve ever had

This is a paid breakdown service and it completely failed.

I reported a breakdown at 17:04. Updates on the app stopped around 00:30 and I had to call RAC myself, only to be told no update or ETA could be given. In reality, the job had effectively been cancelled — without telling me. Had I not called, I would never have known.

By around 01:00 the job disappeared from the app entirely. No call. No message. No notification. I was left stranded all night in my car, 20 miles from home. I even told RAC I might have to leave my car unattended just to walk to work.

A new job was later created, but the response time given was 8am–11am the following day. Even from the point the new job was raised, this still meant a minimum 8-hour wait. That is completely unacceptable for a breakdown service.

Awful communication, no ownership, and no concern for customer safety. I would not rely on RAC again

Not Recommended 
My car broken down at roadside and I call the RAC at 9:35am to report my breakdown so I ask them about the patrol vehicle so they told me it will show in the app but after 1 hour of wait I call them again to know about my patrol because it's not showing me in the app when I speak to them so they tell me your breakdown is not reported, After 1 hour of wasting time, RAC report my breakdown, when they report my breakdown so my patrol time were a wait of 3-4 hours but the patrol time were change every single time and a long wait of 7/8 hour when I call the RAC so they told you are in safe location so you need to wait, After a wait of 13/14 hour they give me a recovery truck at Midnight(12am) but in this long 🕰️ and waste of time, I didn't receive any single help form RAC👎.

reviews.title: No contact details
reviews.text:
The app works fine but if you need direct contact with someone, forget it. I thought at least you’d be able to ring to report a breakdown but the number I eventually found just directed me back to a web form. 

I can think of many situations where you might want or need to phone instead. In my case, I wasn’t sure if I could use the app ‘rescue’ request for a home start. But what about if it’s difficult to report via the app for accessibility reasons? Or you’re vulnerable and want the reassurance of speaking to someone? I’ll be reconsidering my breakdown cover as I don’t think it’s acceptable to be entirely app-based.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: I already have a car covered by the RAC through Aviva and it appears in the app. However I have  just insured another car and the insurance comes with free RAC cover. I received an email to activate this cover by downloading the RAC app but of course it opens the existing app and only has the existing car showing. If I add the new car it says that the car is not covered. I tried to get help through their help system but it asks for my cover number which I cannot find anywhere in the app (but I can find tons of ads). What is the point of the app if you can only have one car covered regardless of how many cars you actually have covered?

reviews.title: Bad Service
reviews.text: I’ve called in the morning for a breakdown , the time slot showed between 1:30-3:30 then 4:30 till 6:50 , I called up she said she will call back with an update. I received a text message at 7 o’clock saying they can’t make it book a time for tomorrow, when the day wasn’t even finished. The time slot the. Showed 9pm till 12 am , I’ve called up for a manager call back nobody got back , the time slot Dosent meant anything it’s just lies , and just an app to keep you busy.  I will definitely write this review on trustpilot.  And consider cancelling my insurance  when renewal date comes
